Description: Verify signals are correctly driven to idle state after reset.
Expected Result: PSEL=0, PENABLE=0 after reset sequence.

Description: Verify system recovery when reset occurs during SETUP or ACCESS phase.
Master Stimulus: Start transaction, assert PRESETn=0 before PREADY=1.
Expected Result: Transaction is aborted immediately. Master/Slave return to IDLE safely.

Description: Verify single write without wait states.
Expected Result: Data written. 2-cycle completion.

Description: Verify single read without wait states.
Expected Result: Data read matches. 2-cycle completion.

Description: Verify continuous write/read transitions without IDLE.
Expected Result: No dropped packets. PSEL remains 1.

Description: Verify master holds signals during PREADY=0.
Expected Result: Master holds PADDR/PWRITE/PWDATA stable.

Description: Verify watchdog triggers UVM_ERROR when PREADY=0 exceeds limit.
Slave Response: Delay PREADY beyond timeout limit (e.g. 105 cycles).
Expected Result: Watchdog aborts transaction and issues UVM_ERROR.

Description: Verify bus stability when Master delays SETUP and Slave delays PREADY.
Master Stimulus: Drive random idle cycles before SETUP.
Slave Response: Delay PREADY with random wait states.
Expected Result: Data integrity maintained, SVA assertions pass.

Description: Verify slave error reporting.
Expected Result: Monitor captures error, Scoreboard flags it.

Description: Verify behavior on continuous errors.
Expected Result: System remains stable, logs multiple errors.

Description: Verify partial byte lane masking.
Expected Result: Memory correctly masked. Scoreboard aligns bytes.

Description: Verify write with all PSTRB bits low (Zero Strobe).
Slave Response: Respond normally, do not alter memory.
Expected Result: Memory remains unchanged. Scoreboard verifies NO write occurred.

Description: Verify privileged, secure, and data/instruction accesses.
Expected Result: Protocol attributes routed correctly and captured.

Description: Verify PAUSER, PWUSER, PRUSER, PBUSER propagation.
Expected Result: All user signals captured correctly by Monitor.

Description: Verify PWAKEUP timing (Clock Gating).
Expected Result: PWAKEUP asserted at least 1 cycle before PSEL.

Description: Verify APB5 Parity Check signals (PADDRCHK PCTRLCHK PWDATACHK PRDATACHK PREADYCHK).
Expected Result: SVA flags UVM_ERROR for parity mismatch.

Description: Negative test: PENABLE must be 0 in SETUP.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: PENABLE==0 when transitioning IDLE->SETUP.

Description: Negative test: PSEL cannot drop during SETUP->ACCESS.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: PSEL remains 1 until PREADY=1.

Description: Negative test: Master signals must not change if PREADY=0.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: PADDR, PWRITE, PWDATA, PSTRB, PPROT, PNSE, PWAKEUP, PAUSER, PWUSER stable.

Description: Negative test: Address alignment.
Expected Result: ASSERTION/COV: PADDR is aligned to DATA_WIDTH.

Description: Negative test: PSLVERR only evaluated when PREADY=1.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: PSLVERR should not be sampled/asserted active without PREADY=1.

Description: Negative test: No outstanding transactions allowed.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: Cannot start new SETUP phase before current ACCESS phase completes.

Description: Negative test: SETUP phase must transition to ACCESS in exactly 1 cycle.
Expected Result: ASSERTION: (PSEL && !PENABLE) |=> (PSEL && PENABLE)

Description: Catch rare corner cases.
Expected Result: Zero functional drops, memory matches.

Description: Test system robustness under random resets.
Expected Result: System recovers properly every time.

Category: Checks that when reset is lifted, the bus defaults to IDLE (PSEL=0, PENABLE=0).
Checks that in the first cycle of a transaction (SETUP phase), PENABLE must be 0.
Checks that SETUP phase transitions strictly to ACCESS phase in exactly 1 clock cycle.
Checks that PSEL is held high while waiting for Slave to assert PREADY.
Checks that all Master signals (PADDR, PWRITE, PWDATA, PSTRB, etc.) remain perfectly stable while waiting for PREADY.
Checks that Slave Error (PSLVERR) is only asserted and valid when PREADY is high.
Checks the non-pipelined nature of APB: PENABLE must drop after a transaction completes.
Checks APB5 Clock Gating feature: PWAKEUP must be asserted before PSEL.
Checks that the address is properly aligned to the data width boundary (e.g., 4-byte aligned).
